name: Marvion Inc.
summary: Marvion Inc., along with its affiliated entities, operates an online platform dedicated to the creation and distribution of media and entertainment content. This platform serves a diverse audience, including filmmakers, content creators, production houses, distributors, and end-consumers, both in Hong Kong and across international markets. The company extends a suite of services, encompassing financing, business development strategies, and related professional support. It also delivers strategic business and management consulting, offering expert guidance to clients to ensure compliance with regulatory and industry practice requirements. Additionally, Marvion is involved in cutting-edge non-fungible token (NFT) solutions, undertakes IT development, provides research & development as well as IT consulting expertise, and offers treasury management services. Established in 2008, the entity was previously known as Bonanza Goldfields Corp. before officially rebranding to Marvion Inc. in January 2023. It is headquartered in Singapore.
